exposure: Mode of delivery (primary cesarean section vs. others)
Infants born by other modes of delivery
Infants born by primary cesarean section
outcome: Copeptin levels at day 3 of life
cohort: 241 healthy newborn infants (131 boys and 110 girls)
finding: Sexual disparity of copeptin is already present at birth, indicating increased activation of the AVP system in newborn boys as compared with girls.
mod_finding: In infants born without stress, that is by primary cesarean section, male gender was the sole variable associated with copeptin.
